announce.ended: Disconnected from {{server}}. See the bar above the chat for what to do next.
announce.tcp: Voice now runs over TCP because UDP is blocked. Audio may be slightly delayed.

bar.keyboardHint: Enter connects. Alt plus Up or Down arrow moves the server. Shift plus F10 opens more options.

dialog.addressHint: For example mumble.example.org. You can also paste a mumble:// link here.
dialog.filledFromLink: Filled in from the mumble:// link.
dialog.label: Name in the server bar
dialog.passwordHint: Only needed if the server asks for one. It is kept in your system's secure storage.
dialog.passwordKeepHint: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one.

errors.port: Enter a port between 1 and 65535. Most servers use 64738.
errors.username: Enter the name you want to use on this server.
errors.link: This mumble:// link can't be read. Check that it was copied completely.
errors.invalid: The server details aren't valid. Check the address and port.

errors.serverUnreachable: The server can't be reached. Check the address and port, and that you are online.
errors.wrongPassword: The server password is wrong. Edit the server and enter the right password.
errors.nameInUse: Your name is already in use or registered to someone else on this server. Edit the server and choose another name.
errors.certificateRejected: The certificate check failed: either the server's certificate was not trusted, or the server did not accept your identity. Try again, or ask the server owner.
errors.certificateChanged: The server's certificate has changed and was not trusted. Only trust it after the server owner confirms the change.
errors.invalidAddress: The server address isn't valid. Edit the server to fix it.
errors.secureStorage: Your system's secure storage isn't available, so the server password could not be read or saved. Unlock it and try again.
errors.notFound: This server is no longer saved.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

remove.title: Remove {{server}}?
remove.message: Its saved password, certificate decision, followed channels and chat history on this computer are deleted.

switch.title: Switch server?
switch.message: You can only be on one server at a time. Disconnect from {{current}} and connect to {{next}}?

cert.newIntro: Mumcord hasn't seen the certificate of {{server}} before. If the server owner gave you a fingerprint, check that it matches. Your choice is remembered.
cert.changedWarning: The certificate of {{server}} is different from the one you trusted before.
cert.changedAdvice: This can happen after the server was renewed, but it can also mean someone is intercepting your connection. Only continue if the server owner confirmed the change.

rejoin.label: Rejoin last channel
rejoin.text: You were in {{channel}} last time – Rejoin?

status.label: Connection status
status.reconnecting: Reconnecting… (attempt {{attempt}} of {{max}}, next try in {{seconds}} s)
status.tcp: Connected via TCP (UDP blocked). Voice works but may be slightly delayed.

actionFailed.reorder: The new server order couldn't be saved. Please try again.
actionFailed.remove: The server couldn't be removed. Please try again.

empty.title: Add your first server
empty.description: Enter the address you got from your group, or paste a mumble:// link.
empty.noLinkInClipboard: The clipboard doesn't contain a mumble:// link. Paste or type the address above.
empty.pasteManually: Mumcord couldn't read the clipboard. Click the field above and press Ctrl+V.

errors.required: Enter a server address or a mumble:// link.
